$comment: Negative-path acceptance checklist for the myGFO eTechLog. EVERY assertion here must FAIL when exercised — these are the paths where a wrong result is silent. Regenerate with: node scripts/gen-negative-path-checklist.mjs
purpose: Objective portion of Tech Log UAT. Positive-path testing cannot find any of these.

layers.DB: Enforced by the database engine — ledger table type, constraint, or index
layers.API: Enforced server-side on the request path, before commit
layers.ENGINE: Pure logic, portable from the handed-over module
layers.UI: Enforced only by what the interface offers — never sufficient on its own

assertions.assertion: UPDATE a signed defect row
assertions.note: Append-only ledger rejects UPDATE at the engine.

assertions.assertion: DELETE a signature row
UPDATE repair_due_date_utc on a signed deferral
UPDATE an audit_trail row
Verify the ledger digest against Blob storage
assertions.note: An append-only table you never verify is a promise, not a proof. Run on a schedule, not just at UAT.

assertions.assertion: Insert a second row with an existing supersedes_id
assertions.note: Unique partial index on supersedes_id. wouldFork() is the friendly error path only.

assertions.assertion: Two concurrent requests supersede the same parent
assertions.note: An application check cannot do this — both requests can pass it and both insert. Test with real concurrency against the real database.

assertions.assertion: A rejected fork writes supersede_conflict + audit_trail
Read an entity with a 3-deep supersede chain
CRS sign-off with no A&P certificate on file
CRS insert with ap_certificate_number NULL, posted directly
assertions.note: CHECK constraint — the API guard alone is defeated by a direct write.

assertions.assertion: RII sign-off where inspector OID equals performer OID
RII sign-off by an inspector unauthorized for that ATA chapter
Deferral against an MEL item in DRAFT
assertions.note: validateMelDeferrable(). Was UI-filter-only before this handover.

assertions.assertion: Deferral against an MEL item in PENDING_FSDO
Deferral against a SUPERSEDED MEL item
Second extension on a Cat B or C deferral
Any extension on a Cat A or D deferral
Commit a payload whose content_hash disagrees with the server recomputation
assertions.note: WRONG IMPLEMENTATION TO GUARD AGAINST: recomputing and storing the recomputed value. That always succeeds and silently destroys the attestation. Recompute to COMPARE, then reject.

assertions.assertion: Alter any covered field after signing, then verify
Emit null for a missing certNumber instead of omitting the key
Client and server hash the same payload
Accept a client-supplied signedAtUtc as authoritative
Verify a signature written under an earlier payload_version
assertions.expected: verifies using that version field set

assertions.assertion: Edit a mel_item, re-read a deferral signed under the prior revision
Remove the (O) procedure from a mel_item, re-open a signed briefing
assertions.note: A real defect found by adversarial review 2026-07-26: deferralsRequiringAck() read the live oProcedure, so editing the MEL could make a mandatory acknowledgment appear or vanish on a signed briefing, invisibly.

assertions.assertion: Ship MMEL revision N+1, render a deferral signed under revision N
Replay a mutation with the same idempotency key
Replay after a lost ACK
Same payload, different idempotency key
assertions.note: The key is the identity, not the payload.

assertions.assertion: Sync a superseding row before its parent
assertions.note: Client outbox must order by supersede chain.

assertions.assertion: Sign offline, kill the app before sync
assertions.expected: record survives and syncs on relaunch
assertions.note: Decides whether the system is trustworthy at an airfield with no signal.

assertions.assertion: Two devices sign the same entity offline, then both sync
